newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real drops 0.06 pct in calm trading.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real drops 0.06 pct in calm trading.

text.p: Brazil's real dropped 0.06 percent to close at 1.0827 per dollar in calm trading in the commercial foreign exchange market, dealers said.

The real traded around 1.0823 per dollar throughout the day and dropped further in late afternoon, when some banks apparently bought dollars to cover a financial sell or import transaction, dealers said.
Despite the real's drop, preliminary figures for commercial and financial forex contracts showed a $35 million surplus at 1635 local/1935 GMT.
In the interbank floating rate market, the real closed flat at 1.0877 per dollar.
In the parallel market, the real dropped 0.17 percent to close at 1.150 per dollar, traders said.
